pageProps.title: Santa Claus's Wife
pageProps.review: A book review of Keigo Higashino's work that easily and interestingly explores the fixed ideas we take for granted in daily life through a manga format, starting with the question 'Does Santa always have to be a man?'
pageProps.content:
## Review This is a book I picked up wondering if Keigo Higashino wrote such a book. At the time, it would have been a book that challenged Japan's old-fashioned ideas. Starting with ```Does Santa always have to be a man?```, it was a work that allowed me to think about what other stereotypes we take for granted.
Expressed in manga, the questions approached gently without being heavy.
